commentary: With benchmark indices reclaiming 25,250 and market breadth registering a healthy 58 score, the tape reflects a constructive Stage 2 environment with renewed institutional inflows. However, William O'Neil and Jesse Livermore taught us that an advancing market only rewards genuine market leaders, not indiscriminate buying. As Mark Minervini mandates, market health permits progressive exposure only when chart breakouts coincide with undeniable fundamental acceleration (CANSLIM C+A). In this tape, selectivity is paramount: prioritize verified Stage 2 leaders with expanding margins and clean volume-tested bases, while ruthlessly filtering out non-confirming earnings, deteriorating micro-caps, and misclassified passive debt vehicles.
limitations: Daily scan observations are not fills or performance results.
Price levels are scanner references, not live quotes.

360ONE.technical: Clearing its 20-session high at 1224.12 on 1.98x volume confirms constructive demand. Moving averages align above rising 50-day and 200-day lines, and RSI 67 confirms positive momentum without exhaustion. However, the pivot lacks a tight multi-week VCP contraction.
360ONE.fundamental: AUM grew 31% YoY to ₹9 lakh crore and operating revenue rose 17.5%, but mark-to-market treasury hits caused Q2 FY27 net profit to fall 4.4% YoY. High ROE (~20%) persists, yet earnings deceleration caps eligibility under strict O'Neil criteria.
360ONE.risk: A breakdown below the 1146.64 stop invalidates the pivot, warranting immediate trade liquidation to prevent extended drawdown.

AAREYDRUGS.technical: Trading above EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200, attempting a double-bottom neckline breakout at 114.91 on 1.57x volume. While ranges have tightened, long-term relative strength remains weak compared to broader pharma leadership.
AAREYDRUGS.fundamental: Severe fundamental deterioration fails CANSLIM criteria: latest quarterly revenue plummeted 56.3% YoY and profit dropped 25.5%. Low ROCE (5.6%), weak interest coverage, and declining promoter holdings make this a low-quality microcap turnaround candidate.
AAREYDRUGS.risk: Failure to hold the 104.66 support invalidates the double-bottom pattern; cut losses swiftly.

AARTIPHARM.technical: Pristine Stage 2 structure. Price trades cleanly above EMA21, SMA50, and rising SMA200, resolving a textbook double-bottom base at 1003.40. RSI at 69 and expanding MACD highlight institutional accumulation and exceptional relative strength.
AARTIPHARM.fundamental: Outstanding CANSLIM profile: Q2 FY27 PAT jumped 156% YoY and revenue expanded 47% on surging CDMO and API demand. EBITDA margins broadened 450 bps to 22.2%. Conservative debt-to-equity (0.36) provides robust fundamental support.
AARTIPHARM.risk: Violation of the 914.25 support breaks base structure, dictating an immediate defensive exit.

AARVI.technical: Cleared its 20-session high at 161.16 on 3.08x volume, demonstrating definitive supply absorption. Moving averages display bullish alignment (price > EMA21 > SMA50 > SMA200), though high daily volatility requires controlled position sizing.
AARVI.fundamental: Technical staffing model delivers strong profit growth (+57.9% YoY in Q1 FY27) with high promoter ownership (73.4%) and fresh multi-year contract wins. However, thin operating margins (2.6%) and revenue growth just under 15% limit full qualification.
AARVI.risk: A breach below 145.61 breaks the breakout shelf; exit immediately to preserve capital.

ABDL.technical: Positioned above EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200 within a Stage 2 structure. Re-testing the 767.67 double-bottom trigger with RSI 63 and positive MACD indicates steady accumulation, though volume confirmation on breakout is still required.
ABDL.fundamental: Spirits manufacturer showing turnaround momentum: Q2 FY27 sales grew 15.9% YoY and PAT rose 31.6% on record case volume and premiumization. Debt reduction and rating upgrades (IND AA-) reinforce the balance sheet, though EPS YoY remains below 25%.
ABDL.risk: A drop below 711.18 invalidates the double-bottom pivot, triggering strict stop discipline.

ABGSEC.technical: Low-volatility instrument consolidating near 118.12 above short-term moving averages. Completely lacks the explosive volume profile, price momentum, and relative-strength characteristics demanded by Minervini and Darvas strategies.
ABGSEC.fundamental: Passive exchange-traded gilt fund tracking sovereign Indian debt; standard CANSLIM metrics (sales, EPS, margins, ROE, promoter holding) are fundamentally non-applicable. Offers zero corporate earnings growth driver.
ABGSEC.risk: Breakdown under 116.51 signals stop failure; capital is better allocated to high-alpha equity setups.
